en.title: Three Sites Made 215,128 'Best Software' Pages for AI, Cited by Perplexity
en.hook: Examine how programmatic SEO spam exploits modern AI search engines and influences citations.
key_takeaways: Over 215,000 automated spam pages generated by AI content factories
Vulnerabilities in how AI search engines like Perplexity cite sources
The growing crisis of SEO manipulation and trust in modern AI search

zh.title: 三个网站为 AI 批量生成 215,128 个“最佳软件”页面并被 Perplexity 引用

现代 AI 搜索中日益严峻的 SEO 操纵与信任危机
